fusions.name: Two-Tined Prick
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then splits to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Parting Ways
fusions.desc: Looses 2 stings in two directions at once, each dealing 10 damage and stunning what it hits for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Forked Flight
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 20% for 10 seconds. A second pair of stingers fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Splitting Off
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a second sting branches off to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
